title: A Component With RECURRENCE-ID Carries No RRULE, RDATE or EXDATE

citations.verbatim_quote: If present, this JSCalendar object represents one occurrence of a recurring JSCalendar object. If present, the "recurrenceRules" and "recurrenceOverrides" properties MUST NOT be present.

A VEVENT (or VTODO) component is a recurrence override if it has the RECURRENCE-ID property set, and the iCalendar object contains a VEVENT (or VTODO) component that does not have the RECURRENCE-ID but the RRULE property set, and the UID property values of the two components are equal. The component without the RECURRENCE-ID property is in that case referred to as the "main component".

statement: A VEVENT/VTODO that has RECURRENCE-ID has no RRULE, no RDATE and no EXDATE. The only exception is scenario initial_components explicitly flagged as legacy shared-UID input (R-L3-009); such components are never valid output.
rationale: Under draft-ietf-calext-jscalendar-icalendar Section 2.1.2 every same-UID component with RECURRENCE-ID is a recurrence override of the main component, i.e. it represents one occurrence; RFC 8984 Section 4.3.1 forbids an occurrence object (recurrenceId) from carrying recurrenceRules. A RECURRENCE-ID component carrying RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE is therefore not representable in the CalExt model and is ambiguous in RFC 5545 (it has the primary key of one instance, RFC 5546 Section 2.1.5, but generates many).
